title: Day 4 — The Log
_comment: Logwatch day (#46). Rulebook inherited from day_01.json.
_comment_script: Slot 0 first, deliberately: after-hours access ALONE is innocent, and the player needs to meet that before they meet the two that are not. 1 is the loud brute-force read, 5 the stuffing sweep, 3 the quiet insider one.

rule_sheet.summary: Logwatch is live. It shows the whole day's traffic, not just your applicant — finding their lines in it is the job today.
notes: A wall of failed logins from their account is a deny.
One source hitting many accounts with a few tries each is a deny — that is a stuffing sweep.
Logins from two places nobody could travel between in the time is a deny.
After-hours access on its own is a flag. Plenty of people work late.
After-hours access WITH privilege escalation is a deny.
A login IP that does not match the claimed one is a flag — corroborate before denying.
